question: Should Crabpot advance its ClawRouter fixture to upstream `36d26b3`, including the newly introduced direct Polymarket betting capability, once the fixture artifacts are regenerated?
rationale: The update imports a materially different external plugin surface, and repository policy makes the resulting fixture output part of the reviewed contract; source inspection cannot choose whether that new capability belongs in the fixture set.

options.title: Adopt with refreshed fixtures
options.body: Accept the upstream capability, regenerate the fixture report/test expectations, and require passing source-mode and package-mode smoke evidence before merge.

options.title: Defer this pin
options.body: Keep the existing ClawRouter fixture revision until maintainers explicitly want the betting-capability surface covered by Crabpot.

recommendation.title: Adopt with refreshed fixtures
recommendation.body: Accept the upstream capability, regenerate the fixture report/test expectations, and require passing source-mode and package-mode smoke evidence before merge.
